text: Truck Ins. Exch., Inc. (1995) 11 C4th 1, 28, 44 CR2d 370, 385; Liberty Surplus Ins. Corp. v. Ledesma & Meyer Const. Co., Inc. (2018) 5 C5th 216, 225-226, 233 CR3d 487, 493-494—insured employer, sued for negligently supervising employee who molested plaintiff, entitled to defense because its intentional act of negligent supervision had the unintended effect of facilitating the molestation (relying on policy definition of “accident”)] (3) [3:366] Workers' compensation exclusion: Injuries arising from termination of employment are excluded by the workers' compensation exclusion to the extent they fall within the workers' compensation laws (see ¶ 3:314).
